competences.description: With an attack that always lands as a Critical Hit, removes 1 beneficial effect from the enemy with a 75% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
Attack will always land as a Critical Hit

competences.description: Defends the ally target for 3 turns and instantly recovers your turn. Receives half of the damage inflicted on the defended target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattacks the enemy target.

effets.description: The caster of this skill will receive half of the damage inflicted on the escorted target while making the damage dealt to the defended target to 0 and counterattack the enemy target.
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with a spell that summons the power of darkness. This attack has a 75% chance to remove beneficial effects and a 75% chance to block beneficial effects from being granted on them for 2 turns. The damage of this skill is proportionate to your MAX HP.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
All beneficial effects will be blocked
